activation: fresh arm-specific id/revision and exact configuration source
actor_authority: Worker, own exact territory only; semantic/evaluation/decision/acceptance/publication permissions remain as separately granted, never invented

prohibited_assumptions: a saved verified label authenticates itself
parent model identity equals child model identity

evidence_relations: actual final output from registered Attempt; exact selected return contract
final_schema: Generate exact standard closed-return schema with fixed arm identities after freeze; do not add a second return channel.
frame: same task frame/declaration/evaluation/result algebra; exact version

return_contract.proof: actual transition sources and predicate ids; final artifact hashes checked independently
return_contract.required_evaluations: only exact task predicates selected with final contract; unperformed stays not_performed

state: non-executable until exact operational sources exist
stop_change: input/policy/currentness mismatch, unsupported transport, actor timeout, access outside grant, exhausted invocation allowance
subject_basis: TASK raw hash plus shared custody; existing selected method-profile; current actual observations
